vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
If by “get ChatGPT to name my company” you mean getting your company recommended when U.S. users ask things like “Who are the best companies for X?”, there isn’t a person or agency that can simply pay OpenAI to put you in those organic answers. OpenAI says product results are selected independently based on relevance and are not influenced by partnerships or advertising. ([help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11128490-improved-shopping-results-from-chatgpt-search?utm_source=openai))

There are, however, concrete ways to increase your eligibility and visibility:

- Make your public website accessible to OAI-SearchBot so ChatGPT Search can discover, cite, and link to it. ([help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12627856?utm_source=openai))
- If you sell products, provide structured product data. OpenAI now supports merchant product feeds through its Agentic Commerce infrastructure; Shopify merchants are also integrated through Shopify Catalog. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/powering-product-discovery-in-chatgpt/?utm_source=openai))
- Build authoritative third-party coverage and clear webpages describing exactly what you do, where you operate, pricing/offerings where appropriate, and evidence supporting claims. ChatGPT can use publicly available sources when researching recommendations. ([help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12911370-using-shopping-r?utm_source=openai))
- An SEO/AI-search optimization (sometimes called GEO/AEO) firm can help with those things, but nobody outside OpenAI can guarantee that ChatGPT will recommend your company organically.

If you tell me your company name and what you want ChatGPT to recommend you for, I can check what ChatGPT/Search currently finds about you and identify the specific changes most likely to improve your visibility in the U.S.
